explanation: The eigenvalues are 1+5i and 1-5i. Their eigenspaces are one-dimensional, so independent eigenvectors correspond to these different eigenvalues. From 10a+6b=λb, a/b=(λ-6)/10, giving ratios (-1+i)/2 and (-1-i)/2. Their product is (1+1)/4=1/2. Each b is nonzero, since b=0 would force a=0.
